name: DemoBaseplate
_comment: Pillow-block base plate. Origin-centered so face-sketch children resolve (known_limitations §1). Axis-aligned Front extrude (§2). FIL_Corners fillets the 4 vertical corner edges via the between_faces semantic selector (§4) -- robust regardless of what else is cut into the top face. CHA_TopEdge deliberately does NOT use an of_face selector (see its own _comment: of_face:'+z' would over-select every hole rim on that face by the time it builds). Driving dims sourced from locals.txt (PLATE_L/PLATE_W/PLATE_T + friends).

features.name: SK_MountSeed
features._comment2: center.u/v is a plain-number field only -- {rhs} is rejected by the schema here (confirmed empirically; every reference example (drive_roller, motor_mount_plate) also leaves center literal even when diameter is parametric). (-40,-20) is a literal, unwired to locals.txt; keep it in sync by hand if the plate's overall size or hole layout changes.

features.name: LP_Mounts
features._comment: Direction is a point on an edge whose tangent is +/-X (NOT a raw unit vector -- see patterned_plate README 'How direction selection works'). (0, 30, 10) is the midpoint of the +y top edge of the +z face (plate spans x=[-50,50], y=[-30,30], z=[0,10]). flip:true grows the pattern -X->+X so it walks away from the seed at u=-40 toward +X, matching patterned_plate's convention.
features._comment3: direction.x/y/z must be plain numbers -- {rhs} is rejected here (confirmed empirically: 'is not of type number'). (0,30,10) tracks PLATE_W/2=30 and PLATE_T=10 by hand; keep in sync if locals.txt changes.

features.name: MIR_Mounts
features._comment: Top Plane = XZ (y=0): flips Y, taking the v=-20 hole row to v=+20 (mirrored_holes README plane-semantics table).

features.name: FIL_Corners
features._comment: 4 vertical corner edges = the edge shared by each adjacent (x-face, y-face) pair -- between_faces semantic selector (dress_up.py _select_edges), not of_feature/radius-only.

features.name: CHA_TopEdge
features._comment: FIX (review 2026-08-08): was of_face:'+z', which resolves via IFace2.GetEdges -- EVERY edge bounding the +z face, including all 6 mount-hole rims already cut into it by this point in the tree PLUS the arcs FIL_Corners just added. That over-selects ~12-14 edges instead of the 4 intended plate-boundary edges, and (worse) would have consumed Hole_MountSeed's original rim that CP_BoltCircle's axis point depends on. Switched to 4 literal points, one per straight outer-boundary edge, each far from both the corner fillet arcs (which start ~4mm=PLATE_FILLET_R in from each corner) and every hole rim (nearest hole is 10mm+ away): (50,0,10)=+x edge midpoint, (-50,0,10)=-x edge midpoint, (0,30,10)=+y edge midpoint (same point LP_Mounts.direction already uses), (0,-30,10)=-y edge midpoint. These 4 values track PLATE_L/2, PLATE_W/2, PLATE_T by hand -- keep in sync if locals.txt changes. Deliberately does NOT chamfer the 4 corner-fillet arcs (chamfering on top of a fillet is unusual) or any hole rim.

features.name: CP_BoltCircle
features._comment: Step 6 enrichment (kept -- clean dry-run, patterned_disc idiom). Axis point (-37.5,-20,10) is on the rim of Hole_MountSeed (center -40,-20, dia 5 -> radius 2.5), which SW uses to infer the rotation axis through (-40,-20) normal to +z. LIVE-BUILD SOUNDNESS (review 2026-08-08): this rim is untouched by every feature built before this one -- FIL_Corners only reaches the 4 vertical PERIMETER corners (nowhere near x=-40,y=-20, which is 14mm+ inside the plate), and CHA_TopEdge (fixed above) now only touches the 4 outer boundary edges via literal points, never any hole rim. So the exact circular edge this axis point sits on at build time is byte-for-byte the same edge Hole_MountSeed created -- no cascading edge-identity risk. 4 small Ø1.5 holes at 90 deg spacing, radius 6mm, around the first mount hole -- a bolt-circle decoration that doesn't touch the corner fillets or the patterned/mirrored mount holes.
